_comment: Wording for the Customize screen's card on arranging the dashboard, kept out of the component so the text can be edited without reading JSX. Rendered by ./CustomizeYamlNotice.tsx.
title: Ask your AI to arrange it
summary: Tell an AI how you want your dashboard laid out, and it makes the change. Every change can be undone under History.
paragraphs: Apps you install through MOS appear on your dashboard by themselves. Add to Homepage covers the rest: an app already running on your network, or a website link.
For everything else, such as grouping, ordering, renaming and layout, ask your AI:
steps: Connect it under Settings → AI assistants.
Set Suite Manager to See and do.
Say what you want: "move Photos above Files", "put the media apps in one column".
closing: Each change is saved under History below the editor, so you can go back to any earlier version.

Rather not connect an AI? Copy everything in the editor into any AI chat, such as ChatGPT, ask for the change, and paste its answer back here. Press Save and apply. Broken YAML is refused, so a bad answer cannot break your dashboard, and History keeps the version before.
callout: It can add website links, but not apps on your network. Use Add to Homepage for those, so nothing points at an address that doesn't exist.
